d: The CommScope Ready™ WBE-EMT-BK-1P-PNL is a compact indoor wall-mounted fiber enclosure designed for fiber termination and splicing applications. It accommodates one ReadyPATCH® module or one splice tray and supports up to two PNL-type adapters for pre-terminated cable deployments. The enclosure features a durable steel construction and is intended for enterprise and building entrance fiber installations.
